PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  May 9, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, April 25, 2019,
at 2:00 pm in the Community Room “A”, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer – 2:05 pm
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Sgt. Shaun Jennings, Police Department
  Marissa Fewell, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the permit request for
  Daniel Kash DBA LAX Ammo to conduct a Parking Lot Sale at 234 Hindry
  Ave, May 18-19, 2019, from 9:00 am – 5:00 pm, subject to event being
  contained exclusively to the location listed on this application; cannot
  obstruct or use public sidewalks, streets or alleys; sales of firearm
  ammunition to any persons without proper/legal government-issued
  identification is strictly prohibited; loitering inside/outside the business
  location is strictly prohibited; Possession or sales of any
  illegal/unauthorized firearms, ammunition, equipment or items deemed to
  be a hazard to public safety are strictly prohibited; all events are subject to
  random inspection by an police, fire or code enforcement officer or official
  at any time during hours of operation; business owner is required to
  possess all applicable local, county, state and/or federal licensing for sales
  of items; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; LAX Ammunition staff is to maintain
  and manage crowd control throughout the duration of the event; Security
  guards carrying firearms must be authorized and licensed with the Bureau
  of Security and Investigative Services; armed and/or unarmed security
  guards shall wear distinctive uniforms to be easily identified by the public;
  any person directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible retro-reflective
  vests; ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; adhere
  to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including
  noise and signage, local, state and federal laws.subject to Hire two (2) City
  Licensed professional security guards to monitor crowd.; Motion carried
  unanimously. (Activity No. 00274936)

  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of business license renewals (Nos. 1-13) as recommended, with Listing
  #4 Stay High LAX being pulled, (Activity 250389) as recommended.
  ; sales of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah,
  vapor and e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited;
  persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have
  valid identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; “NO
  LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING” signage
  must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and cannabis
  products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used
  to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine,
  including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke
  and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or
  display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners
  and/or new applicants or their designees is subject to random Permits &
  Licensing establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any
  Police and Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is
  to enforce business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by
  the City of Inglewood and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties,
  social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes,
  live bands/music, disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business
  owner(s) is required to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all
  applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried unanimously.
